The same probe against the pre-phase module (c3fd6eca~1, no sidecar in the picture at all) lost an event in 1/40 trials, and neutralising this phase's reclaim arm did not remove it (1/15), so the hole is the pre-existing leftover-generation eviction path, not surface phase 4 added. Filed here as a record, not as a phase-4 gap.

Wording caveat on item 7, not a defect: a contender that reads ABANDONED (or that evicts a leftover generation) publishes its stamp to the shared path BEFORE the eviction rename, so a writer that loses that rename has touched the shared sidecar. It cannot restart a dead claimant's clock, which is what the item protects - on the in-flight arm the losers return before publish() is ever reached (cadence-core/bin/lib/trace.mjs:803-812).
